note: Network and Kubernetes Security pathway: Week 5 of the 60-day calendar, presented as a focused pathway for learners targeting network, cloud and Kubernetes security products.

pathway.title: Network and Kubernetes Security
pathway.summary: Containers, Kubernetes networking and network policy, hands-on with a local cluster and Calico, and case study 2: a flow from observed traffic to a recommended policy, staged before it is enforced. These are Week 5 and the case study 2 days of the 60-day calendar, grouped here for learners going deep on cloud network security.
pathway.forWho: Designers targeting network, cloud or Kubernetes security companies such as Tigera. If identity or AI is your focus, you can make these days optional in Settings → Content and use the AI Security pathway's practice lesson as your second case study.
